inputs.text:
Look at how these progressive activists and out-of-touch critics try to undermine successful enterprise. The owner of Blue Waters is simply pointing out the heavy burden of government taxation, noting they pay taxes “without doing or investing in anything.” Yet, left-wing agitators twist this into an attack on private capital, demanding heavy-handed state control, systemic reform, and strict regulations that stifle the economy and punish industriousness. 

Instead of respecting the dignity of hard work, enterprise, and personal responsibility, these critics whine about plastic bottles blocking rivers and drains, blaming business owners for broader societal decay. They love to talk about working-class communities, but their solution is always more big government, more bureaucracy, and an assault on the traditional pillars of commerce and wealth creation that keep our nation strong. We don't need socialist regulations; we need to respect the people who actually build and run our economy.
